title: Chenchu people - Wikipedia
text: The Chenchus are a Dravidian tribe, designated as a Scheduled Tribe in the Indian states of Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka and Odisha. [2] They are an aboriginal tribe whose traditional way of life has been based on hunting and gathering.
